name: Minamoto no Yoshitsune
source:
"Now then... that concludes today's inspections."

Based on Minamoto no Yoshitsune, who was a general of the Minamoto clan of Japan in the late Heian and early Kamakura period.

Strong in mind and body, Yoshitsune is a well-rounded hero capable of completing most tasks with ease. She governs Kyoto together with [url=https://vndb.org/c5211]Benkei[/url] and holds a deep bond of trust with the people.

She is also in charge of [url=/c5184]Himiko[/url] and Benkei's education. She is calm and collected, wise beyond her years, and a natural beauty, but is said to be affected by a certain complex.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char01c]English official site[/url]]
